newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: Seoul stocks seen rising on improving sentiment.
newsitem.headline: Seoul stocks seen rising on improving sentiment.

text.p: Seoul stocks are expected to rise on Tuesday on hopes for an economic turnaround, but brokers said profit-taking would limit sharp gains.
"Even though the won's depreciation is still a negative factor, investors believe the worst is over for the economy," said Woo Sang-chul of Tongyang Securities.
Brokers said advanced buying of core blue chips by domestic institutions would continue ahead of a rise in the foreign stock ownership ceiling on May 2.
The composite stock index closed on Monday 7.48 points higher at 694.90.
"But the market will face a mild consolidation following recent rises," Woo said.

Brokers said many investors would pay close attention to continuing parliamentary hearings on the collapsed Hanbo Group. They said investors were concerned the prosecution probe might expand further, if there were unexpected developments.
